name: Fluorescein (dianion)
description: Abs ~490 nm / Em ~515 nm (pH > 8). The open dianion is the bright species.

name: Erythrosin B
description: Tetraiodofluorescein. Abs ~526 / Em ~550 nm. Heavy-atom effect: strong triplet yield.

name: Rose Bengal
description: Tetrachloro-tetraiodofluorescein. Abs ~549 / Em ~570 nm. Efficient singlet-oxygen sensitizer.

name: Rhodamine B
description: Abs ~554 / Em ~577 nm (EtOH). Classic laser dye and tracer.

name: Rhodamine 6G
description: Abs ~530 / Em ~552 nm. Quantum yield ~0.95; the standard laser dye.

name: Tetramethylrhodamine (TMR)
description: Abs ~550 / Em ~575 nm. Common label for proteins and antibodies.

name: Texas Red
description: Sulforhodamine 101 sulfonyl chloride. Abs ~589 / Em ~615 nm.
